data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure and step order (From/To, date, passengers/class, Confirm, Show flights, Select fare), but it omits the total passenger count as a parameter, only covers children and infants, and gives no concrete value for the cabin or fare selection, so an automation would need guesswork.
